Auto.CliHelp:
sr "RULE NAME OR ID"
Run a rule from any folder using an already running copy of SonicRoute. Put rule names with spaces in quotes.
Use sr --legacy "RULE NAME" to target the Legacy edition. SonicRoute takes priority when both editions are running.
Reopen your terminal after the first launch of this version. If SonicRoute isn’t running, the command fails without launching the app.

SonicRoute.exe --run-rule "RULE NAME OR ID"
Run a saved rule directly, even if its automatic trigger is disabled. Steps run in their configured order with their usual delays.
A running instance handles the request. Otherwise, SonicRoute starts, runs the rule, and exits. The result is printed as one line of JSON.
Exit codes: 0=success, 1=step failed, 2=invalid arguments, 3=rule not found, 4=duplicate name or ID, 5=busy, 6=server unavailable, 7=canceled, 8=internal error.
